customManagers.description: uzi CI tool pins carrying a `# renovate: datasource=.. depName=..` annotation on the line directly above the version literal, for pins WITHOUT a companion sha256 (currently zizmor in ci.yml). config:recommended already tracks go.mod / package-lock / Dockerfile FROM / GHA uses:; this covers versions pinned inline in shell that no built-in manager sees, VERSION only. Pins that DO have a companion sha256 (go-task, sqlc, actionlint) use the `# renovate-tarball:` marker + the github-release-attachments manager below instead, so their sha bumps in lockstep -- do NOT give a sha-carrying pin the `datasource=` marker or both managers would match it.

uzi CI tool pins that curl a GitHub release tarball and `sha256sum -c` it (go-task in .github/actions/setup-task, sqlc + actionlint in ci.yml, per-platform golangci-lint archives in scripts/golangci-lint.sh). The github-release-attachments datasource makes Renovate bump the VERSION and companion sha256 together in one PR: it resolves the new asset's sha256 from the release checksum asset or by hashing it. The *_VERSION literal MUST be the v-prefixed git tag because getDigest fetches releases/tags/<value> verbatim; shell code may strip the leading v for versionless asset names. An optional packageName lets distinct depName aliases prevent Renovate's same-file deduplication while resolving one upstream package. Marked `# renovate-tarball:` so the version-only generic manager above does NOT also match these. Linter/codegen pins (sqlc drift, actionlint findings) still arrive red-with-work by design; go-task and golangci-lint arrive with complete hashes.

packageRules.description: workers.image.repository is a PREFIX (controller appends /agent-<template>), not a resolvable image; and the worker tag is operator-advanced/decoupled from appVersion (PRD #422 Decision 1/3), so it must not be Renovate-tracked.
shellcheck is pinned in two managers (ci.yml tarball+sha via github-release-attachments; Taskfile lint:shell arg via github-releases). Group so a bump moves both in lockstep in one PR.
golangci-lint: group the Taskfile version and both platform archive hashes for every update. Distinct depName aliases avoid same-file deduplication; shared packageName joins them here.
Go toolchain: keep major and minor go/golang updates eligible for one branch without grouping their patch or digest refreshes.
Go toolchain: group major/minor go.mod/toolchain and setup-go updates with golang builder images. Patch and digest refreshes stay independent.
Go toolchain: a major/minor golangci-lint update must land with the Go surfaces so its build-Go supports the selected toolchain.

KinD toolchain: group helm/kind-action and kindest/node because the action downloads a default kind that must understand the node image's kubeadm API. KinD smoke remains the gate for one-sided releases.
